blocks.content: Soil is a dynamic natural body that develops at the Earth's surface as a result of the interaction between lithosphere, atmosphere, hydrosphere and biosphere. It is not merely weathered rock but a living system containing minerals, organic matter, air, water and countless microorganisms. Soil acts as the foundation of terrestrial ecosystems and agriculture.

items: Soil development involves four interconnected Earth spheres: Lithosphere, Atmosphere, Hydrosphere, and Biosphere.
Questions often emphasize that soil is a dynamic living system containing biotic and abiotic components, not just static weathered rock.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Soil is formed at the Earth's surface through the interaction of four spheres: lithosphere, atmosphere, hydrosphere, and biosphere.
Soil is a dynamic living system containing minerals, organic matter, air, water, and microorganisms, rather than simple weathered rock.
It serves as the essential foundation for both agriculture and terrestrial ecosystems.
